QuestInfo.name: Pipopa's Investigation
QuestInfo.0: #p9120014# in Showa Town is investigating a case. It looks like it's not going very well...
QuestInfo.1: It seems there's been an issue collecting evidence crucial to the case. Perhaps you should offer your assistance.\n\n#t04000984# #c04000984#/100
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the evidence to #p9120014#. Hopefully this will help solve the case.

0.0: I'm so close to cracking the case... If only I had a little help...
0.1: You there. You seem quite skilled. Would you assist me in maintaining public order in Showa Town? I'm afraid I can't go into detail. Secrecy is of the utmost importance at this stage of an investigation.

yes.0: Yes! I had a feeling you'd agree to help us. I want you to gather #t04000984# x100, evidence I need to solve the case I'm investigating.
yes.1: You'll find them by defeating #o9400013#s. You can find #o9400013#s hiding somewhere in the map closest to the Kinoko Shrine.
yes.2: This is a dangerous mission but I know you can do it. Good luck.

no.0: It's a shame that someone with such gifts won't put them to use for the public good.
no.1: Well, let me know if you change your mind.

1.0: Oh my, I never imagined you'd finish this difficult task so quickly. Here, please accept this reward.
1.1: Thank you. I'll put this to good use.

item.0: Hmm, you don't have enough evidence. We can't solve the case like this. Put in some more effort.
